extension.summary: 雾汐｜Kodi 22 轻量透明皮肤，需 Mistuary Helper，可选 Emby for Kodi NextGen
Lightweight transparent skin for Kodi 22, requires Mistuary Helper and optionally Emby for Kodi NextGen
extension.description:
基于 Estuary N 改造的小而美皮肤，需要 Kodi 22 及以上。 依赖插件 Mistuary Helper，请先安装插件再切换皮肤；搭配 Emby for Kodi NextGen 可原生适配动态节点。
Mistuary Helper 提供：服务端中文搜索、详情页豆瓣评分、媒体库封面同步、 播放列表补全（按季 / 按目录 / 跨季），以及文件播放记录 —— 在文件管理器里播过的视频会记住进度，下次起播可选择「继续播放」， 焦点行还有圆环显示已播比例（Kodi 原生只对库内条目续播）。
详情页评分支持 TMDb / IMDb / 豆瓣 / 烂番茄（同时最多两个）， 技术标识按分辨率 / HDR / 杜比视界档位 / 编码 / 声道图标化。 透黑、透白双主题，页面 / 浮窗 / 播放中三档透明度各 6 级可调； 8 套屏幕比例自适应（16:9 / 18:9 / 21:9 等），另有音乐黑胶模式与电源菜单。

A compact, polished skin built on Estuary N. Requires Kodi 22 or newer. Requires the Mistuary Helper add-on - install it before switching skins. With Emby for Kodi NextGen it natively follows dynamic nodes.
Mistuary Helper provides server-side Chinese search, Douban ratings in the video info dialog, media-library cover sync, playlist completion (by season / by folder / next season), and file playback resume - videos played from the file manager remember their position, offer “resume from h:mm:ss” on the next start, and show a progress ring on the focused row (Kodi only resumes library items natively).
Ratings from TMDb / IMDb / Douban / Rotten Tomatoes (up to two at a time); technical flags are shown as icons (resolution, HDR, Dolby Vision profile, codecs, channels). Dark and light transparent themes with six levels each for pages, popups and playback; eight aspect ratios supported, plus a vinyl mode and a power menu.
extension.disclaimer: Weather, radio and game browsing surfaces are intentionally omitted.
本皮肤有意省略天气、电台和游戏浏览界面。
